subject: general
question: Which ministry launched a new logo and a mascot named "Sankhyiki" in January 2026?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** unveiled a new corporate identity in **January 2026** to modernize its public image and enhance data transparency.

• The launch included a new official **logo** and a mascot named **Sankhyiki**, which is the Hindi term for **Statistics**, representing the ministry's core function of data management.

• The mascot **Sankhyiki** is designed to act as a bridge between the government and the public, making the interpretation of **official statistics** more accessible and engaging for citizens.

• This initiative is part of a larger reform to strengthen the **National Statistical System (NSS)** and align Indian statistical standards with global benchmarks for **data accuracy** and **reliability**.

• The rebranding reflects the ministry's shift towards **digital-first** reporting and the integration of **big data analytics** in tracking **socio-economic indicators**.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)**:

• It was created in **1999** through the merger of the **Department of Statistics** and the **Department of Programme Implementation**.

• The ministry oversees the **National Statistical Office (NSO)**, which is responsible for conducting the **Annual Survey of Industries (ASI)** and the **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)**.

• It is the nodal agency for releasing high-frequency data such as the **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** and the **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)**.

• **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)**:

• Focuses on the **Digital India** program, **cybersecurity**, and the promotion of **electronics manufacturing** in the country.

• **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**:

• Manages the **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)** and handles **Wholesale Price Index (WPI)** calculations.

• **Ministry of Finance**:

• Coordinates with **MoSPI** for the preparation of the **Economic Survey** and the allocation of the **Union Budget** based on statistical forecasts.

</ul
